blocks.html: The storage, handling, processing and transporting of flammable and combustible liquids in Group H-2 and H-3 occupancies shall be in accordance with the New York City Mechanical Code, the New York City Fire Code, and Sections 415.9.1.1 through 415.9.1.9 of this code.
